title: Add JSON output to peers revoke
summary: Add a `--json` flag to `covenant peers revoke` so automation can distinguish Revoked/AlreadyRevoked/NotFound/Ambiguous without scraping stderr.
expectedFailureModes: Automation scripts scrape stderr and misclassify ambiguous matches as success.
`--json` output changes exit codes or mixes human + JSON output, breaking parsers.
JSON output includes full token bytes or other redacted registry data.
nextAction: Implement `covenant peers revoke --json` with a stable outcome schema and keep human output unchanged by default.
